$comment: Every executable, script, key, database or archive permitted in the shipping
Windows artifact, by exact path. Checked by scripts/package-inventory.mjs.
Adding a path here is a decision about what users receive. Document the
binary in docs/security/BINARY-POLICY.md in the same pull request, and never
add a certificate or key path — those must not exist in the repository at all.
Paths are relative to dist/win-unpacked and use forward slashes.
